recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖，男性（XY），第 7 號染色體位置只有一條，箭頭指出缺少的另一條，即 45,XY,-7（monosomy 7）；在兒童骨髓衰竭中出現 monosomy 7 支持 MDS（如 RCC），並提示進展風險高。
features: Single chromosome 7 with arrow marking the absent homolog
All other autosomes present in pairs without obvious structural rearrangement at this resolution
describe_en: G-banded karyogram from a male shows 45 chromosomes with loss of one chromosome 7 (arrow), and no other numerical or apparent structural abnormality at this band resolution. A clonal loss requires identification of the same monosomy in at least three metaphases. The karyotype is interpreted as 45,XY,-7. In a child with cytopenias and a hypocellular or dysplastic marrow, monosomy 7 supports myelodysplastic neoplasm such as refractory cytopenia of childhood and indicates a high risk of progression, warranting evaluation for GATA2 or SAMD9/SAMD9L germline predisposition.

ddx.vs: A 7q deletion shows two chromosome 7 homologs with one shortened long arm rather than a missing whole chromosome.
Artifactual chromosome loss is seen in isolated metaphases, whereas clonal monosomy must be present in at least three metaphases.
Monosomy 7 in children can be acquired on a germline predisposition background, which requires germline testing rather than karyotype to identify.
